items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-19
items.q: it was fortunate enough to have people like Sterling Bowes and Irving Fazola in the band.

ctx.x: Because I lived here. But in getting out of town, when I went to college, I went to Temple University in Philadelphia. And at that time, I came with an enormous collection of phonograph records. Because I couldn't really see myself surviving through the period of a college education without the music. So I had this large collection of records. Now, it happened that this was a time of a reawakening of an interest in American popular music, especially among people who were interested in swing. But even among these…
Now, had you done any of this kind of thing before?
